content.description: "Review" gathers what waits for the BA by kind ("Findings", "Rules", "Removals", "Processes", "Records to confirm", "Assumptions to check", "Unexplained differences", "Amendments to re-anchor", "Assistant proposals", "Probe suites to approve", "Edit conflicts"), with filters, keyboard shortcuts and group decisions ("Confirm 2" / "Reject 2" with "Reason for 2"). content.description: "What changed" lists the changes first seen in a chosen range ("From" / "To" model versions, "Or from a date", "Or from a scan", release links), grouped by process and screen and filtered by "Kind" ("New screen", "Variant", "New action", "Removed", "Leads elsewhere", "Result changed", "Rule broke") and "Process". content.description: "Screens" offers four views ("List", "Map", "Recorded pages", "Access"). The list filters and sorts screens; a screen page shows its variants, actions (where each leads), amendments and history; the map draws the screens and links with views, layers and a process overlay; recorded pages list every recorded state with probe status; access shows which persona reached which screen and which elements differ.

content.title: Explore the screen model

content.description: "Processes" lists the BA's processes with stage, process models, live marks, screens and amendments, the assistant's suggested groupings and the screens in no process. A process page shows its facts from the portal model, its paths, the as-is documentation status with the stage control ("Stage", "Set stage", "Mark as-is documented"), and the steps of the selected process model (reorder, remove, "Add screen"); it offers "Merge with…", "Archive" and "Start a to-be design". "History" marks which model is live per environment and lists every revision; "Documentation" shows the rebuild-grade export.

content.definition: Help and glossary: "Who the crawler acts as during a run, such as an anonymous guest, defined in a persona file that can only narrow what the portal config allows." Settings lists each persona with the credential names it needs, its attributes (e.g. "segment premium") and "logged-in" or "anonymous"; Access by persona compares what each persona reached.
content.title: Persona

content.definition: One session of the crawler against one portal; the glossary calls it a run: "One session of the crawler against one portal, as one persona, in one mode, and everything it recorded on the way." Statuses: "Completed", "Running", "Stopped" and "Interrupted" ("it can be resumed without repeating recorded work"). The console lists scans with persona, kind, status and steps ("<used> / <max>").
content.title: Scan (run)

content.definition: Help and glossary: "What a run is for, either map mode, which explores the whole portal, or trace mode, which records one named process step by step." A scan page shows it as "Mode · environment" (e.g. "map · local-dev").

content.definition: One way a screen was seen (r1, r2, …); the first is the "Baseline" ("The first way the screen was seen.") and "A second one appears here when a scan sees this screen differently (another release, persona or state)." Its reason is one of "Release", "Persona", "Error", "A/B test", "Data", "Unknown".
content.title: Variant

content.definition: A version of a part of the documented portal (e.g. "5696", "7f03" of the part "Shell"); without a release marker "releases are told apart by the names of the page's files". Portal home lists "Releases by part"; the Changes timeline links each release to the changes from it.

content.definition: The items that wait for a decision by the BA (findings, rules, records to confirm, assumptions, …), counted on All portals ("Need you"), Portal home, Review, Changes and each screen ("Needs you on this screen"); opposite of "Explained automatically" and "Decided".

content.definition: A change the portal model found that waits for an explanation, e.g. "New screen on …" marked "Unexplained" ("No rule explained it yet."), with a "Before / after" view; one of the kinds of decision in Review.

content.definition: A versioned sequence of steps of a process, labelled by a letter and revision ("A r3"); the as-is model holds "Observed screens, documented per step", and a to-be model is started with "Start a to-be design". A model can be marked live per environment.

content.definition: How far a process is in documentation and migration: "Suggested", "Scoped", "As-is documented", "To-be in design", "Migrating", "Migrated"; "A process can move back at any time."

content.definition: The documentation of how a process works today, written per step from the observed screens; its status on a process page lists what is "Still open on these screens" (open questions, records to confirm, amendments to re-anchor) and it is closed with "Mark as-is documented". content.definition: The similarity above which two recorded pages count as one screen (0.90 in the run): "The threshold τ says how similar; labelled pairs (same screen or not) calibrate it, and a classifier trained on them can replace it when it tells pairs apart better." Same screen? asks first about the pairs nearest τ.
